system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

Beyond just your own, you are now capable of controlling any smoke, gas, haze or cloud, by mixing particles of your ashen chakra into it.

As a reaction to entering, or beginning your turn within an effect described as a cloud, gas, haze or smoke, you can make a Ninshou check using your Hijutsu Flexibility score to calculate its results vs the effects Jutsu save DC. If the effect does not have a Jutsu save DC, then instead, use the Standard Level DC of the effect.

On a success, you take control of the area, able to reshape it or move it as a bonus action on your turn. You also gain immunity to its effects. When you command it as a bonus action, you can either move it 20-feet into, using its center most space as the space that moves, or reshape it into a 20-Foot Radius sphere. Apply its effects using your highest jutsu save DC to calculate its Saves or effects. The casting creature loses concentration, and you begin concentration, but at no chakra cost, for up to 1 minute.
